00285ea73aa3.en: Eori, unfazed by all the blood, steps toward him. "I finally found you! Let's go back home, Harry!" Magi, firm, her bow drawn and pointed at the ground: "He's mine until I turn him in to the Embassy!" Eori realizes she's an adventurer. "All right, fine! Do what you must, but I'll follow you there."
00285ea73aa3.t: Eori, tidak terganggu dengan semua darah itu, melangkah ke arahnya. “Akhirnya aku jumpa kau! Jom balik rumah, Harry!” Magi, tegas, busurnya ditarik dan dihala ke tanah: “Dia aku punya sampai aku serahkan dia ke Kedutaan!” Eori sedar dia seorang pengembara. “Okey, baiklah! Buat apa yang perlu, tapi aku akan ikut kau ke sana.”

0318e3518f0d.en: The contractor leaves. Ryo: "Have you found your girls yet?" "I'm working on it. I only have time to review one or two a day." "Hmmm. Can I watch the auditions?" "But you can't participate, or I won't be able to review their fuckability." "In all my years, I've never heard that. Seems legit."
0318e3518f0d.t: Kontraktor beredar. Ryo: “Kau dah jumpa gadis-gadis kau?” “Tengah usahakan. Aku cuma ada masa untuk nilai seorang dua sehari.” “Hmmm. Boleh aku tengok uji bakat?” “Tapi kau tak boleh ikut serta, nanti aku tak dapat nilai sejauh mana mereka sedap dimain.” “Sepanjang hidup aku, tak pernah aku dengar macam tu. Nampak sah.”

0540e577f755.en: "Princess Eori! You must stop at once!" The same citizen appears again. "FUCK OFF! THIS PIECE OF SHIT IS NOT HARRY!" Eori has had it. The citizen looks around, gravely concerned. "Princess Eori! This is a trap!" He reaches for his sword, but stops when he sees Magi aiming at him instead. Magi, angry: "Who are you?"
0540e577f755.t: “Puteri Eori! Tuan puteri mesti berhenti segera!” Rakyat yang sama muncul lagi. “BLAH LA! TAIK NI BUKAN HARRY!” Eori sudah tidak tahan. Rakyat itu melihat sekeliling, sangat risau. “Puteri Eori! Ini perangkap!” Dia mencapai pedangnya, tetapi berhenti apabila nampak Magi menghala kepadanya pula. Magi, marah: “Siapa kau?”

060df52879e7.en: She backs away quickly and keeps walking down the main road. As she walks, her eyes grow heavy again. She slaps herself, drawing everyone's attention; thinking she's crazy, they all leave her be. The girl in pink wakes up a bit and speed-walks on.
060df52879e7.t: Dia cepat-cepat berundur dan terus berjalan di jalan utama. Sambil berjalan, matanya menjadi berat lagi. Dia menampar dirinya, menarik perhatian semua orang; menyangka dia gila, mereka semua membiarkannya. Gadis berbaju merah jambu itu tersedar sedikit dan berjalan laju.

06c67eb3ad5c.en: Ryo hugs them both. "I'd take both, but Katsumi has a dream of her own, and this place will help her get there. All right, let's take a tour." The assistant shows them around the dump.
06c67eb3ad5c.t: Ryo memeluk kedua-duanya. “Aku nak ambil dua-dua, tapi Katsumi ada impian sendiri, dan tempat ni akan bantu dia capai impian tu. Okey, jom kita tengok-tengok.” Pembantu itu membawa mereka melihat tempat buruk itu.

0819115614fc.en: She knows that if she shows up, she'll be discovered and bring harm to her family. Who could she turn to? She fucked over everyone she knew, burning all her bridges. She hugs her baby Bruntos tight.
0819115614fc.t: Dia tahu jika dia muncul, dia akan ditemui dan membawa bahaya kepada keluarganya. Kepada siapa dia boleh berpaling? Dia telah menganiaya semua orang yang dikenalinya, membakar semua jambatan. Dia memeluk bayi Bruntosnya erat-erat.

08ce4219204b.en: Harry looks at the passed-out Magi, her shivering body, her bluish lips and nails. Not so scary-looking now.
08ce4219204b.t: Harry memandang Magi yang pengsan, badannya yang menggigil, bibir dan kukunya yang kebiruan. Tak nampak menakutkan sangat sekarang.

09a164da99bf.en: Desmond sees her chewing slow down and her head dip forward. With the next blink, she's out cold, falling forward onto the table and spilling her drink. "Hey? Are you okay?" No response. He touches her soft shoulder; nothing. That doesn't look comfortable. He grabs a pillow, and as he tilts her back onto it, she startles awake and slaps his hand away.
09a164da99bf.t: Desmond nampak kunyahannya semakin perlahan dan kepalanya terlentok ke depan. Pada kelipan seterusnya, dia pengsan, jatuh ke depan ke atas meja dan menumpahkan minumannya. “Hei? Kau okey?” Tiada jawapan. Dia menyentuh bahunya yang lembut; tiada apa-apa. Tak nampak selesa tu. Dia mengambil sebiji bantal, dan ketika dia menyandarkannya ke belakang ke atas bantal itu, dia tersentak bangun dan menepis tangannya.

0a2d47c57c72.en: "What do you mean?" She lifts the free bread. "This! You're eating this too!" "There are no leftovers, so this is what I'm eating." "Don't you make, like, fifteen Pearls a day?" "Yeah, but I live here too, so I pay ten a day, and I'm using the rest to pay off this uniform." She chows down on more bread. And I made 2 Pearls in the past two days.
0a2d47c57c72.t: “Apa maksud kau?” Dia mengangkat roti percuma itu. “Ni! Kau pun makan ni!” “Tak ada lebihan, jadi inilah yang aku makan.” “Bukan ke kau dapat, macam, lima belas Pearl sehari?” “Ya, tapi aku tinggal di sini juga, jadi aku bayar sepuluh sehari, dan baki aku guna untuk bayar pakaian seragam ni.” Dia melahap lebih banyak roti. Dan aku dapat 2 Pearl dalam dua hari lepas.

0ccfe277a3b6.en: Harry, straining his eyes, carefully flips things in his wok. "They kicked me out of the kitchen, but I've been watching them. I think I'm getting the hang of it now." Magi, hiding her shivering, asks point-blank: "Desmond from Rebula. How did you get that name?"
0ccfe277a3b6.t: Harry, memicingkan mata, dengan berhati-hati menterbalikkan barang dalam kualinya. “Mereka halau aku dari dapur, tapi aku dah perhati mereka. Rasanya aku dah mula pandai sekarang.” Magi, menyembunyikan gigilannya, bertanya terus: “Desmond dari Rebula. Macam mana kau dapat nama tu?”

0e13bdb9895c.en: {WIP-embassyClerk}, the sweet old clerk from that morning: "You look terrible, honey." "I just want to return this badge, and deposit these Pearls into the guild." Magi shows her own badge next. "Blue-Flower-Red-Bone? Oh! What a delight! How's your father? He was quite the gentleman, even back when he was an Amethyst, like you."
0e13bdb9895c.t: {WIP-embassyClerk}, kerani tua yang manis pagi tadi: “Kamu nampak teruk, sayang.” “Saya cuma nak pulangkan lencana ni, dan simpan Pearl ni ke dalam persatuan.” Magi menunjukkan lencananya sendiri seterusnya. “Blue-Flower-Red-Bone? Oh! Seronoknya! Apa khabar ayah kamu? Dia memang budiman, walaupun masa dia Amethyst, macam kamu.”

0ed597954be8.en: Rounding a corner on her way to buy a drink, Eori sees Harry carrying a box; Magi in the background
0ed597954be8.t: Membelok di sudut dalam perjalanan membeli minuman, Eori nampak Harry membawa sebuah kotak; Magi di belakang

109e5661ac67.en: Yosuke watches Magi pull the bloody arrow out of Harry's back
109e5661ac67.t: Yosuke memerhati Magi mencabut anak panah berdarah dari belakang Harry

10ab9d030c18.en: Magi feels the tension. She wants to capture Harry, but what if he's just a look-alike? She takes too long to decide, and the restaurant's light goes out.
10ab9d030c18.t: Magi merasakan ketegangan. Dia mahu menangkap Harry, tetapi bagaimana kalau dia cuma pelanduk dua serupa? Dia mengambil masa terlalu lama untuk memutuskan, dan lampu restoran padam.

116a9083aec7.en: Magi turns in her quest at the Embassy

14e83042280e.en: Harry's memory snaps back. He looks around for her, ready to run. "Where's Eori?" "She left already. A guy named Morika took her away." Harry sighs in relief, then his mind clicks. Wait. Why didn't my badge light up?
14e83042280e.t: Ingatan Harry kembali serta-merta. Dia melihat sekeliling mencarinya, bersedia lari. “Mana Eori?” “Dia dah pergi. Seorang lelaki nama Morika bawa dia pergi.” Harry mengeluh lega, kemudian fikirannya tersentak. Kejap. Kenapa lencana aku tak menyala?

16f6ea400c0a.en: Eori changes her appearance. "If that's what you want, mother, then I can play this game too." Outside, the town crier keeps going: "Desmond! Come back to us! Yosuke and the team."
16f6ea400c0a.t: Eori menukar rupanya. “Kalau itu yang bonda mahu, aku pun boleh main permainan ni.” Di luar, pelaung bandar terus melaung: “Desmond! Kembalilah kepada kami! Yosuke dan pasukan.”

16f8b0ea8361.en: Eori flips her shit and goes back to her dorm. She remembers Coema's letter, and it clicks: someone is holding Harry hostage, using his fake body. She's pissed she didn't heal him, or interrogate him. She "wears" a fake skin and mask made from her roommate, {WIP-eoriRoommate}, so she can escape looking like her.
16f8b0ea8361.t: Eori hilang sabar dan kembali ke asramanya. Dia teringat surat Coema, dan barulah dia faham: seseorang menahan Harry sebagai tebusan, menggunakan badan palsunya. Dia bengang kerana tidak menyembuhkannya, atau menyoal siasatnya. Dia “memakai” kulit dan topeng palsu yang dibuat daripada rakan sebiliknya, {WIP-eoriRoommate}, supaya dia boleh melarikan diri dengan rupa seperti gadis itu.

1af6bbec6308.en: Chapter 2 - Stocking the fires of love.

1cf72788ec2f.en: They talk about the opportunity. Yosuke tells Dalila not to steal food, or he'll punish her this time. Dalila feels the stress.
1cf72788ec2f.t: Mereka bercakap tentang peluang itu. Yosuke memberitahu Dalila jangan curi makanan, atau dia akan menghukumnya kali ini. Dalila rasa tertekan.

1d0d758dc610.en: People are staring at this pink adventurer. Magi jumps up—"I'M SORRY!"—and takes off running, clutching her green bag as she hears them murmur, baffled. "HEY! YOU LEFT YOUR BOW AND BAG!" She stops: she's holding her green bag, but she left everything else behind. She walks back in shame.
1d0d758dc610.t: Orang ramai merenung pengembara berwarna merah jambu ini. Magi melompat bangun—“MAAF!”—dan memecut lari, memeluk beg hijaunya sambil mendengar mereka berbisik, kebingungan. “HOI! KAU TERTINGGAL BUSUR DAN BEG!” Dia berhenti: dia memegang beg hijaunya, tetapi dia meninggalkan semua yang lain. Dia berjalan balik dengan malu.

1d91f6d8364f.en: More of Magi on the job. She starts to fall asleep and reaches for her Mind Quicken (another spelling of Time Quicken), but she's run out. She falls asleep, falls out of the tree, and wakes up surrounded by Bagarisas.
1d91f6d8364f.t: Lebih banyak tentang Magi semasa bekerja. Dia mula tertidur dan mencapai Mind Quickennya (ejaan lain bagi Time Quicken), tetapi sudah habis. Dia tertidur, jatuh dari pokok, dan terjaga dikelilingi Bagarisa.

1dc2058e48bc.en: Ryo: "This is the best you found?" His assistant, {WIP-ryoAssistant}: "That's the best I could find. If you'd given me 5 more Sapphires, I could have haggled for something else." "Well, I do like a challenge. Anyway, I guess we should introduce ourselves." He does.
1dc2058e48bc.t: Ryo: “Ini yang terbaik kau jumpa?” Pembantunya, {WIP-ryoAssistant}: “Itu yang terbaik saya boleh jumpa. Kalau tuan bagi saya 5 Sapphire lagi, saya boleh tawar-menawar untuk yang lain.” “Yalah, aku memang suka cabaran. Apa-apa pun, rasanya kita patut perkenalkan diri.” Dia berbuat begitu.

24d2f11ad16a.en: Magi, tired, returns the badge to the clerk
24d2f11ad16a.t: Magi, penat, memulangkan lencana kepada kerani

255f7340bf18.en: Magi sits down again and looks at her tattered clothes. "I'm sorry, Jonem." (Jonem is her little brother.)
255f7340bf18.t: Magi duduk semula dan memandang pakaiannya yang compang-camping. “Maafkan kakak, Jonem.” (Jonem adik lelakinya.)

25c09a2844a9.en: Magi, alone, at an end table by the wall in a loud tavern
25c09a2844a9.t: Magi, seorang diri, di meja hujung tepi dinding di sebuah kedai minum yang bising

25d932dbb3da.en: Eori: "What the fuck do you want?" Magi: "I borrowed the badge from the clerk this morning! I've been tracking him since yesterday!" Eori looks confused. "What does that have to do with anything? I'm the princess of Sanbi! Harry is mine!" "Step away, or I'll shoot him!"
25d932dbb3da.t: Eori: “Apa celaka kau nak?” Magi: “Aku pinjam lencana daripada kerani pagi tadi! Aku dah jejak dia sejak semalam!” Eori nampak keliru. “Apa kaitannya? Aku puteri Sanbi! Harry aku punya!” “Ke tepi, atau aku tembak dia!”

28e63356b350.en: "He's mine!" A cutesy voice breaks up the lovely (if one can call it that) situation.
28e63356b350.t: “Dia aku punya!” Satu suara comel memecahkan situasi yang romantik itu (kalau boleh dipanggil begitu).

29717b83b04d.en: Ryo and Katsuki at lunch in a restaurant north of Forway; Katsuki devours even more Barinas
29717b83b04d.t: Ryo dan Katsuki makan tengah hari di sebuah restoran di utara Forway; Katsuki melahap lebih banyak Barina

2b3317d1e039.en: Ryo does the budget with Katsuki while Katsumi shows off her things, construction going on around them
2b3317d1e039.t: Ryo membuat bajet bersama Katsuki sementara Katsumi menunjuk-nunjuk barangnya, kerja pembinaan berlangsung di sekeliling mereka

2def99f16c1c.en: Magi, arrow ready; Eori, sweaty, holds a sweaty Harry against the wall and glares at Magi
2def99f16c1c.t: Magi, anak panah sedia; Eori, berpeluh, menekan Harry yang berpeluh ke dinding dan menjeling Magi

2f69411edb18.en: Harry falls forward, but catches himself and keeps stumbling on, a trail of blood droplets following him out the door and into the crowd. "Princess Eori! You can't leave the game!" A citizen with a sword on his back appears on the stairs. Eori looks at him, flips him the bird, and takes off after Harry.
2f69411edb18.t: Harry jatuh ke depan, tetapi sempat menahan diri dan terus terhuyung-hayang, jejak titisan darah mengikutinya keluar pintu dan ke dalam orang ramai. “Puteri Eori! Tuan puteri tak boleh tinggalkan perlawanan!” Seorang rakyat dengan pedang di belakangnya muncul di tangga. Eori memandangnya, menunjuk jari tengah, dan memecut mengejar Harry.

2fc8fec232d7.en: Arukia, hiding her face, with the Bruntos at a nari gel stand; among the options, she sees Harry
2fc8fec232d7.t: Arukia, menyembunyikan mukanya, bersama Bruntos di sebuah gerai nari gel; antara pilihan, dia nampak Harry

30c80a25e7c4.en: Hanako and Mimi come to Harry's rescue. Hanako offers Eori her hand. "We're sorry for the trouble he caused." "HE BETTER FUCKING BE!" Eori, realizing she's at a stalemate of strength with Harry, stops forcing herself on him and slaps Hanako's hand away as she stands up.
30c80a25e7c4.t: Hanako dan Mimi datang menyelamatkan Harry. Hanako menghulurkan tangan kepada Eori. “Kami minta maaf atas masalah yang dia timbulkan.” “BAIK DIA MINTA MAAF, CELAKA!” Eori, sedar kekuatannya seimbang dengan Harry, berhenti memaksa dirinya dan menepis tangan Hanako ketika berdiri.

31626ae26453.en: The teacher drags her along to help with a contract; Eori snaps at the teacher, and the teacher snaps back
31626ae26453.t: Guru itu mengheretnya untuk membantu dengan satu kontrak; Eori membentak guru itu, dan guru itu membentak balik

33813ba6c9c2.en: Magi smiles, but her sad expression blurs the smile. She watches Desmond, the white-haired guy, help someone with their bill, grab something to drink, then bring all the leftover Breadplates over to her. He looks familiar— Desmond starts chowing down on them too. The pink adventurer looks at him, confused, then angry. "Are you mocking me, like everyone else?"
33813ba6c9c2.t: Magi tersenyum, tetapi wajah sedihnya mengaburkan senyuman itu. Dia memerhati Desmond, lelaki berambut putih itu, membantu seseorang dengan bilnya, mengambil minuman, kemudian membawa semua Breadplate yang berlebihan kepadanya. Dia nampak macam pernah jumpa— Desmond mula melahapnya juga. Pengembara berbaju merah jambu itu memandangnya, keliru, kemudian marah. “Kau perli aku ke, macam orang lain?”

3392d034e47b.en: Magi gets ready to sleep somewhere, close to midnight
3392d034e47b.t: Magi bersiap untuk tidur di suatu tempat, hampir tengah malam

34419dad193c.en: Harry, confused, and Magi sit across from each other, eating Breadplates together
34419dad193c.t: Harry, keliru, dan Magi duduk bertentangan, makan Breadplate bersama

34f738c8eee7.en: Older lady: "Not ordering anything again, pink adventurer?" Magi shakes her head. "Poor you." Magi ends up falling asleep, and suddenly remembers the Gandew duel at the end of Vol 1, which she watched from the background (she has been in the background of the illustrations): she saw Harry's old, fatter form. He has changed a lot, but he still holds some semblance. "HARRY!" The outburst draws several people's attention. A drunk guy: "Hey, baby, toss Harry aside. Come spend the night with me instead!" Magi, disgusted, pushes him aside and leaves the tavern.
34f738c8eee7.t: Wanita tua: “Tak pesan apa-apa lagi, pengembara merah jambu?” Magi menggeleng. “Kesian kau.” Magi akhirnya tertidur, dan tiba-tiba teringat pertarungan Gandew di hujung Jilid 1, yang ditontonnya dari belakang (dia ada di latar belakang ilustrasi): dia nampak bentuk lama Harry yang lebih gemuk. Dia sudah banyak berubah, tetapi masih ada sedikit persamaan. “HARRY!” Jeritan itu menarik perhatian beberapa orang. Seorang lelaki mabuk: “Hei, sayang, lupakan Harry. Mari bermalam dengan aku!” Magi, jijik, menolaknya ke tepi dan meninggalkan kedai minum itu.

375ca1cd8a84.en: Arc #4 - Fishy Conspiracy: the author's story notes (spoilers).
375ca1cd8a84.t: Arka #4 - Konspirasi Mencurigakan: nota cerita pengarang (bocoran).

381e28b232f7.en: Emelia, in the flower shop, hears from bandits that the Sanbi Kingdom has reached out to Arukia's parents
381e28b232f7.t: Emelia, di kedai bunga, mendengar daripada penyamun bahawa Kerajaan Sanbi telah menghubungi ibu bapa Arukia

3ad4f1b38e34.en: "HANAKO! Desmond let his new girlfriend into his room!" Dalila screams at the door. Magi, blushing red, chokes on her food trying to deny it. "I'm not—" A few coughs to clear her throat. "I'm not his girlfriend! I was hunting him down for a missing person quest!" Dalila: "Missing person? So you know who his family is?" Magi shakes her head. "I thought he was Harry from Sanbi, but the badge didn't light up."
3ad4f1b38e34.t: “HANAKO! Desmond bawa teman wanita baru dia masuk bilik!” Dalila menjerit di pintu. Magi, tersipu merah, tercekik makanan cuba menafikannya. “Aku bukan—” Beberapa batuk untuk melegakan tekak. “Aku bukan teman wanita dia! Aku buru dia untuk misi orang hilang!” Dalila: “Orang hilang? Jadi kau tahu siapa keluarga dia?” Magi menggeleng. “Aku ingat dia Harry dari Sanbi, tapi lencana tu tak menyala.”

3cc78b20b2cf.en: Magi, somewhat resentful, and Harry, in disbelief and deep thought, walk back, bloodied
3cc78b20b2cf.t: Magi, agak berdendam, dan Harry, tidak percaya dan tenggelam dalam fikiran, berjalan pulang, berlumuran darah

3d2606a6a70f.en: Magi and Eori stumble on a nari gel stand
3d2606a6a70f.t: Magi dan Eori terjumpa sebuah gerai nari gel

3d51961ed72b.en: Chapter 4 - Ryo, Katsuki in a wagon.

40fdb4bee7fd.en: Magi, in soaked clothes and cold, waits at the table while Harry, in his #13 clothes (the numbers tie in to the illustrations), cooks
40fdb4bee7fd.t: Magi, berpakaian basah kuyup dan kesejukan, menunggu di meja sementara Harry, dalam pakaian #13 (nombor-nombor berkait dengan ilustrasi), memasak

426f765d1d52.en: Harry, on the ground, takes off running with all the might he has, but as he runs, he sees Eori quickly making up ground. He tries to go down the stairs, trips and falls on his hands. He tries to stumble down the rest of the way, then feels a tackle pin him against the wall.
426f765d1d52.t: Harry, di tanah, memecut lari sekuat hati, tetapi sambil berlari, dia nampak Eori cepat merapatkan jarak. Dia cuba turun tangga, tersadung dan jatuh di atas tangannya. Dia cuba terhuyung-hayang menuruni baki tangga, kemudian merasakan terkaman yang menekannya ke dinding.

437d12777000.en: Eori, leaving the scene, hears Morika's steps quickly catching up. She ignores him and keeps walking, anywhere but back to this fake Harry. Morika: "I'll have to report to Neferteri that you lost your—" Eori, in anguish: "Fuck it! Do it! I fucking dare you!" Morika doesn't rise to her anger. Calmly: "Princess Eori, please return to the Nari School with me." Eori, on the fence: "I'll go back by myself. Leave me the fuck alone." "I'm bound by contract not to leave you alone."
437d12777000.t: Eori, meninggalkan tempat itu, mendengar langkah Morika cepat mengejarnya. Dia tidak mengendahkannya dan terus berjalan, ke mana saja asalkan bukan kembali kepada Harry palsu ini. Morika: “Saya perlu melaporkan kepada Neferteri bahawa tuan puteri kehilangan—” Eori, dalam derita: “Peduli apa! Buatlah! Aku cabar kau!” Morika tidak terpancing dengan kemarahannya. Dengan tenang: “Puteri Eori, sila kembali ke Sekolah Nari bersama saya.” Eori, berbelah bahagi: “Aku balik sendiri. Jangan kacau aku, celaka.” “Saya terikat dengan kontrak untuk tidak meninggalkan tuan puteri sendirian.”

445c3b714515.en: Eori gets a letter from Neferteri telling her to support Maiara's championship
445c3b714515.t: Eori menerima surat daripada Neferteri menyuruhnya menyokong kejohanan Maiara

45586fbece6e.en: Magi takes another bite. She watches Desmond as she eats, and something about him seems familiar, and it isn't the Breadplate she's always eating because it's free.
45586fbece6e.t: Magi menggigit lagi. Dia memerhati Desmond sambil makan, dan ada sesuatu tentangnya yang terasa biasa, dan bukan Breadplate yang selalu dimakannya kerana percuma.

476598c7b5a1.en: She hesitates to sign, but does. She takes Harry's badge and puts it away. She feels the pressure of how badly losing it (3 Sapphires) would screw her over: she'd likely spend the rest of her life working for Forway for free.
476598c7b5a1.t: Dia teragak-agak untuk menandatangani, tetapi menandatanganinya juga. Dia mengambil lencana Harry dan menyimpannya. Dia merasakan tekanan betapa teruknya akibat jika kehilangannya (3 Sapphire): dia mungkin akan menghabiskan sisa hidupnya bekerja untuk Forway tanpa bayaran.

4901f585d042.en: Magi pulls out a Nari Refresher. "Not that! I need to keep my current appearance." Keeping her distance, Magi tosses her a nari stone and a ring. "Do it yourself." Eori does. "All right, if you don't trust me, then trust this." She tosses a bag of balls at Magi's feet.
4901f585d042.t: Magi mengeluarkan sebotol Nari Refresher. “Bukan tu! Aku kena kekalkan rupa aku sekarang.” Menjaga jarak, Magi melemparkan sebiji batu nari dan sebentuk cincin kepadanya. “Buat sendiri.” Eori berbuat begitu. “Okey, kalau kau tak percaya aku, percayalah ni.” Dia mencampak sebeg bola ke kaki Magi.

49816c3c8815.en: She heads for Yosuke's restaurant, but her steps grow weaker. What is he running from? Why wouldn't he change himself more? She realizes he was eating with her. Does he work for food and a place to live?
49816c3c8815.t: Dia menuju ke restoran Yosuke, tetapi langkahnya semakin lemah. Dia lari daripada apa? Kenapa dia tak ubah diri dia lebih lagi? Dia sedar Harry makan bersamanya. Dia kerja untuk makanan dan tempat tinggal ke?

4ab9d90e10a9.en: A server comes over. "Whatcha want?" Ryo: "Can we have some juice instead?" The server lists the juices. Ryo looks at Katsuki, eating with a sad face as she eyes the beer jug. "Anything tickle your fancy?" "One—beer." "No deal." She picks a juice. Ryo starts drinking the beer; Katsuki gives him puppy eyes. He puts it aside. "Okay. I'll stop drinking it with you." Katsuki brightens with a smile.
4ab9d90e10a9.t: Seorang pelayan datang. “Nak apa?” Ryo: “Boleh kami dapat jus sebagai ganti?” Pelayan menyenaraikan jus. Ryo memandang Katsuki, makan dengan wajah sedih sambil merenung jag bir. “Ada yang menarik minat?” “Satu—bir.” “Tak boleh.” Dia memilih jus. Ryo mula minum bir itu; Katsuki memberinya mata anak anjing. Dia meletakkannya ke tepi. “Okey. Aku berhenti minum bersama kau.” Katsuki berseri dengan senyuman.

4b4ac170343d.en: Harry sits down, his back aching from all the work. Someone offers him the last bit of Nari Refresher; Harry says he's good. He just needs a beer and some rest instead. Rimir pours him one. "You suck at cooking, but at least you can do the grunt work, unlike a certain someone." Mimi: "I'm helpful too!" They banter.
4b4ac170343d.t: Harry duduk, belakangnya sakit akibat semua kerja itu. Seseorang menawarkannya sisa terakhir Nari Refresher; Harry kata dia okey. Dia cuma perlukan bir dan rehat. Rimir menuangkan satu untuknya. “Kau teruk memasak, tapi sekurang-kurangnya kau boleh buat kerja kasar, tak macam seseorang tu.” Mimi: “Aku pun membantu!” Mereka berbalas usikan.

4ba4a9a0e66a.en: Magi, frustrated: "Okay, I'm sorry. I didn't want to shoot you, but you left me no choice when you took off running. I was within my rights, you know?" Harry remembers seeing her earlier that day. "So you were following me too?" "Yeah, but you're not Harry."
4ba4a9a0e66a.t: Magi, kecewa: “Okey, aku minta maaf. Aku tak nak tembak kau, tapi kau tak bagi aku pilihan bila kau lari. Aku ada hak, kau tahu?” Harry teringat ternampaknya awal hari itu. “Jadi kau pun ikut aku juga?” “Ya, tapi kau bukan Harry.”

4bd72a2b5b1f.en: The sweet old clerk, now voiding the contract: "That's terrible. I hope he's proud of you, fighting to become a Sapphire adventurer too. Sign here." Magi signs. "Anything else, Adventurer Magi?" Magi looks at her, reminded of her late grandma on her father's side, who was just as sweet. "Do you have any easy-money quests?" The clerk offers some, and Magi accepts a few more boring ones.
4bd72a2b5b1f.t: Kerani tua yang manis itu, kini membatalkan kontrak: “Teruknya. Mak cik harap dia bangga dengan kamu, berjuang untuk jadi pengembara Sapphire juga. Tandatangan di sini.” Magi menandatangan. “Ada apa-apa lagi, Pengembara Magi?” Magi memandangnya, teringat arwah neneknya sebelah ayah, yang sama manisnya. “Ada misi duit senang?” Kerani menawarkan beberapa, dan Magi menerima beberapa lagi yang membosankan.

4d8fd3df06a9.en: Yosuke wakes the gang at the crack of dawn

4ec35a98be0b.en: Magi out on a boring quest

51046aeb66a1.en: Harry and the gang in a wagon; Magi follows them in the background
51046aeb66a1.t: Harry dan geng di dalam gerabak; Magi mengekori mereka di belakang

5276921cd5d8.en: The Bruntos climbs onto the bed; she puts it back on the floor. It cries, and the people around her get pissed, so she puts it on the bed to shut it up.
5276921cd5d8.t: Bruntos itu memanjat ke atas katil; dia meletakkannya semula di lantai. Ia menangis, dan orang di sekelilingnya menjadi bengang, jadi dia meletakkannya di katil supaya ia diam.

54d4e4bb6f81.en: She sets up an ambush, and as the person walks into it, Magi releases an arrow at a seemingly random citizen. A girl screams: "You fucking bitch! I was trying to talk to you!" She pulls out her badge, which lights up; Magi can clearly see "Eori Sanbi Royal".
54d4e4bb6f81.t: Dia memasang perangkap, dan ketika orang itu masuk ke dalamnya, Magi melepaskan anak panah ke arah seorang rakyat yang nampak biasa. Seorang gadis menjerit: “Kau jalang celaka! Aku cuba nak bercakap dengan kau!” Dia mengeluarkan lencananya, yang menyala; Magi nampak dengan jelas “Eori Sanbi Royal”.

55105044973d.en: Dalila gasps. "Hanako! Look!" There are balls and a note on the other beds too. Dalila reads it out loud: "I'm sorry. I'll tell you the truth when I come back from the atelier." Magi hands her paper over. "He wrote that to me as well." Dalila looks happy, counting the money she got.
55105044973d.t: Dalila tersentak. “Hanako! Tengok!” Ada bola dan nota di atas katil lain juga. Dalila membacanya kuat-kuat: “Maafkan aku. Aku akan beritahu korang kebenaran bila aku balik dari atelier.” Magi menyerahkan kertasnya. “Dia tulis tu untuk aku juga.” Dalila nampak gembira, mengira wang yang diperolehnya.

59c2bf79697d.en: Guards show up. "The fuck happened here?" Magi pulls out both badges and explains it all; Yosuke pulls out his and confirms it. The guards see that Harry's outfit matches Yosuke's. "All right. Clean this mess up, or we'll come after you."
59c2bf79697d.t: Pengawal muncul. “Apa celaka berlaku di sini?” Magi mengeluarkan kedua-dua lencana dan menerangkan semuanya; Yosuke mengeluarkan miliknya dan mengesahkannya. Pengawal nampak pakaian Harry sepadan dengan pakaian Yosuke. “Okey. Bersihkan kekacauan ni, atau kami datang cari korang.”

59dbb6b10282.en: Magi and Eori at the restaurant near closing time; Hanako and Mimi at the door tell Magi to get fucked
59dbb6b10282.t: Magi dan Eori di restoran menjelang waktu tutup; Hanako dan Mimi di pintu menyuruh Magi pergi mampus

5a25d4695efd.en: "Sorry, adventurer, but we're about to close." A white-haired stranger smiles at her. She holds her cold hands against her chest. "Do you have any Breadplates?" The white-haired guy's smile disappears. He looks inside at some patrons finishing their meals. "We might have some soon. We've got plenty of empty tables too, so come in and warm up."
5a25d4695efd.t: “Maaf, pengembara, tapi kami dah nak tutup.” Seorang asing berambut putih tersenyum kepadanya. Dia memegang tangannya yang sejuk ke dada. “Ada Breadplates?” Senyuman lelaki berambut putih itu hilang. Dia memandang ke dalam pada beberapa pelanggan yang sedang menghabiskan makanan. “Mungkin ada sekejap lagi. Kami ada banyak meja kosong juga, jadi masuklah dan panaskan badan.”

5b7d31fad17f.en: A loud bonk on the table, followed by rattling plates and silverware. Harry turns to see Magi passed out, in what looks like a pretty uncomfortable position. "You okay?" No response. Without wasting time, he finishes cooking, plates the meal and goes to check on the pink adventurer. He touches her limp shoulders and notices how cold she is; her cheeks are bluish too. Well, I told her she could borrow Hanako's clothes while hers dried.
5b7d31fad17f.t: Bunyi hentakan kuat di meja, diikuti pinggan dan sudu garpu bergemerincing. Harry berpaling dan nampak Magi pengsan, dalam kedudukan yang nampak agak tidak selesa. “Kau okey?” Tiada jawapan. Tanpa membuang masa, dia menghabiskan masakan, menghidang dan pergi memeriksa pengembara merah jambu itu. Dia menyentuh bahunya yang longlai dan perasan betapa sejuknya dia; pipinya kebiruan juga. Yalah, aku dah cakap dia boleh pinjam baju Hanako sementara baju dia kering.

5ec80ff347da.en: Arukia gets ready for bed, holding the baby Bruntos
5ec80ff347da.t: Arukia bersiap untuk tidur, memeluk bayi Bruntos

61b5df9d1da2.en: Eori, disguised as a commoner, bleeding from an arrow; Magi realizes she just shot a princess of Sanbi
61b5df9d1da2.t: Eori, menyamar sebagai rakyat biasa, berdarah akibat anak panah; Magi sedar dia baru menembak seorang puteri Sanbi

62a3d3f03d7a.en: The girl with her (Eori): "She has a crush on Har—a crush on Desmond. Now get over it, and just fucking tell us what you know." Magi, blushing, says she doesn't. Hanako: "Har?" Eori: "None of your business."
62a3d3f03d7a.t: Gadis bersamanya (Eori): “Dia minat pada Har—minat pada Desmond. Sekarang lupakan, dan beritahu saja apa korang tahu, celaka.” Magi, tersipu, kata dia tidak minat. Hanako: “Har?” Eori: “Bukan urusan kau.”

648969b246ba.en: Ryo in front of the finished place, with Katsumi, Katsuki and two adventurers
648969b246ba.t: Ryo di depan tempat yang sudah siap, bersama Katsumi, Katsuki dan dua orang pengembara

656af6cf2929.en: Harry spills something and cleans it up as he answers. "I got the name Desmond from someone I knew. Rebula is where I woke up after—" He seems to be mincing his words. "After what?" "Hmmm—never mind. I don't remember much." Magi looks suspicious. "Or you don't want to say?" "Well, I really don't remember some stuff, but other stuff I do. Saying it out loud sounds weird, since I'm not even Harry. I mean, I don't want to make things worse for people now—"
656af6cf2929.t: Harry menumpahkan sesuatu dan membersihkannya sambil menjawab. “Aku dapat nama Desmond daripada seseorang yang aku kenal. Rebula tempat aku terjaga selepas—” Dia nampak berhati-hati memilih kata. “Selepas apa?” “Hmmm—tak apalah. Aku tak ingat banyak.” Magi nampak curiga. “Atau kau tak nak cakap?” “Yalah, ada benda aku betul-betul tak ingat, tapi ada benda lain aku ingat. Cakap kuat-kuat bunyinya pelik, sebab aku bukan pun Harry. Maksud aku, aku tak nak buat keadaan jadi lebih teruk untuk orang sekarang—”

6704cd0cc191.en: Arukia works the farmland under the hot sun
6704cd0cc191.t: Arukia mengerjakan ladang di bawah terik matahari

6a93b1fceab0.en: Emelia: "So Eiri is pulling the strings now? That's odd. Either way, keep tabs, day and night, on every single person Arukia knows. She knows too much!" Bandits: "Do we—"
6a93b1fceab0.t: Emelia: “Jadi Eiri yang tarik tali sekarang? Pelik. Apa-apa pun, perhatikan, siang dan malam, setiap orang yang Arukia kenal. Dia tahu terlalu banyak!” Penyamun: “Patutkah kami—”

6f524cb94e61.en: Eori decides Coema is working with Neferteri too, and gets pissed: she'll use the money Coema gave her to go back to Sanbi and whoop her ass. "We're going to Sanbi." Magi: "What?" "I'm gonna wipe the smirk off Coema's face." "Coema?" "The previous Sanbi King's maid. Let's go."
6f524cb94e61.t: Eori memutuskan Coema juga bekerjasama dengan Neferteri, dan menjadi bengang: dia akan menggunakan wang yang diberi Coema untuk kembali ke Sanbi dan membelasahnya. “Kita pergi ke Sanbi.” Magi: “Apa?” “Aku nak hapuskan senyuman sinis dari muka Coema.” “Coema?” “Bekas King-maid Sanbi. Jom.”

7055ccf675ec.en: Same scene, but a guy goes table to table selling nari gel
7055ccf675ec.t: Babak yang sama, tetapi seorang lelaki pergi dari meja ke meja menjual nari gel

70633e6ad5e3.en: Magi tries to hold back her emotions, but sadness peeks through. "You know him?" "But of course, my dear. I was at the Blood branch of the Embassy for twenty-some years before I was promoted to manage this branch. Say, it's been a while since I heard about him. Did he retire?" "He—he disappeared."
70633e6ad5e3.t: Magi cuba menahan emosinya, tetapi kesedihan terserlah. “Mak cik kenal dia?” “Sudah tentu, sayang. Mak cik di cawangan Kedutaan Blood dua puluh tahun lebih sebelum dinaikkan pangkat untuk mengurus cawangan ini. Eh, dah lama mak cik tak dengar pasal dia. Dia dah bersara ke?” “Dia—dia hilang.”

707ee081e520.en: Yosuke pulls a key from his robe and hands it to Magi. "That's all on you." "What do you want me to do, then?" "It's obvious. Take Desmond back to the restaurant and tell him to wait for me." Magi takes the key. Yosuke starts to leave. "Don't you dare steal anything, or my acquaintances will have a talk with you."
707ee081e520.t: Yosuke mengeluarkan sebatang kunci dari jubahnya dan menyerahkannya kepada Magi. “Semua tu tanggungjawab kau.” “Habis apa encik nak saya buat?” “Jelas sekali. Bawa Desmond balik ke restoran dan suruh dia tunggu aku.” Magi mengambil kunci itu. Yosuke mula beredar. “Jangan kau berani curi apa-apa, atau kenalan aku akan berbincang dengan kau.”

71f41a49392a.en: Eori lets him go. Harry seizes the opportunity and takes off running downstairs. Eori and Magi exchange a look, and both take off after him. Magi leaps from the stairs to gain height, and with a quick fling of her bow, an arrow screams toward Harry and lands in his left lung.
71f41a49392a.t: Eori melepaskannya. Harry merebut peluang itu dan memecut turun tangga. Eori dan Magi berpandangan, dan kedua-duanya memecut mengejarnya. Magi melompat dari tangga untuk mendapatkan ketinggian, dan dengan kibasan pantas busurnya, sebatang anak panah menjerit ke arah Harry dan tertancap di paru-paru kirinya.

7356963f789e.en: Yosuke and the gang finish preparing for tomorrow: Harry skewers food on wooden sticks and hands them to Mimi, who dips them in liquid and passes them to Hanako for the cooler
7356963f789e.t: Yosuke dan geng selesai bersiap untuk esok: Harry mencucuk makanan pada batang kayu dan menyerahkannya kepada Mimi, yang mencelupnya ke dalam cecair dan menghulurkannya kepada Hanako untuk peti sejuk

7359c0febfce.en: Meanwhile, Magi glances at Harry, lost in thought. He was afraid of Eori. Nari Refresher barely changed his appearance, and he clearly fled from Eori. There's clearly something going on here. She touches the pocket where the badge is hidden. What if this badge is fake? She pictures being hanged for saying that out loud.
7359c0febfce.t: Sementara itu, Magi mengerling Harry, tenggelam dalam fikiran. Dia takut pada Eori. Nari Refresher hampir tak ubah rupa dia, dan jelas dia lari daripada Eori. Jelas ada sesuatu berlaku di sini. Dia menyentuh poket tempat lencana itu disembunyikan. Macam mana kalau lencana ni palsu? Dia membayangkan dirinya digantung kerana mengatakannya kuat-kuat.

74bb3faf1760.en: Harry looks back down the road he's walked so many times carrying wares for the restaurant. Who the fuck am I, then? I clearly stole the name Desmond from that Wozen bandit girl. I clearly remember waking up in Sanbi, and everything in between—except nothing from after I ate the Bagarisa nari gel until I woke up in Rebula—if I'm not Harry, then who am I?
74bb3faf1760.t: Harry memandang kembali jalan yang sudah begitu kerap dilaluinya membawa barang untuk restoran. Siapa celaka aku, kalau macam tu? Jelas aku curi nama Desmond daripada gadis penyamun Wozen tu. Jelas aku ingat terjaga di Sanbi, dan semua di antaranya—kecuali tiada apa-apa selepas aku makan nari gel Bagarisa sampai aku terjaga di Rebula—kalau aku bukan Harry, siapa aku?

74e0d159395a.en: Mimi and the gang ignore her, and she feels bad about what she said. She keeps walking until she notices someone following her. She picks up her pace, and so does the other person.
74e0d159395a.t: Mimi dan geng tidak mengendahkannya, dan dia rasa bersalah dengan apa yang dikatakannya. Dia terus berjalan sehingga perasan seseorang mengekorinya. Dia mempercepatkan langkah, begitu juga orang itu.

75d42a960002.en: Magi doesn't respond; she seems dissatisfied too, and starts to think it over. Did she just stumble into a conspiracy? What should she do? Could it be the same one that made her father disappear? Hanako: "Fine! We'll find him on our own!"
75d42a960002.t: Magi tidak menjawab; dia nampak tidak puas hati juga, dan mula memikirkannya. Adakah dia baru tersandung ke dalam satu konspirasi? Apa patut dia buat? Mungkinkah ia konspirasi yang sama yang membuat ayahnya hilang? Hanako: “Okey! Kami cari dia sendiri!”

7badea78d8f3.en: Magi, bloodied, is confused by Harry's appearance
7badea78d8f3.t: Magi, berlumuran darah, keliru dengan rupa Harry

7d1808935457.en: They banter, and Harry is left with menial tasks. Hanako notices Harry keeping an eye on everything around him. "Are you expecting someone or what?" "Of course not." Yosuke: "I'm watching you!" Dalila: "I'm taste-testing the base!" Yosuke flips something perfectly, and Rimir pours something over it in unison.
7d1808935457.t: Mereka berbalas usikan, dan Harry ditinggalkan dengan tugas remeh. Hanako perasan Harry memerhati segala yang ada di sekelilingnya. “Kau tunggu seseorang ke apa?” “Mestilah tak.” Yosuke: “Aku perhatikan kau!” Dalila: “Aku rasa kuah asas!” Yosuke menterbalikkan sesuatu dengan sempurna, dan Rimir menuang sesuatu di atasnya serentak.

8033abba8bcb.en: She opens a bag of balls: an Aquamarine, plus change. She opens another letter from Coema: "Good Princess! Now wreak havoc! Have fun! Light it up! Make Neferteri red with anger! Make sure to fully change your appearance, and don't use mail, or anything that needs your badge, or they'll find you quickly. The withdrawal I preauthorized for you should last a few weeks if you invest it wisely. Break free! Do what you want!"
8033abba8bcb.t: Dia membuka sebeg bola: satu Aquamarine, ditambah duit kecil. Dia membuka satu lagi surat daripada Coema: “Puteri yang baik! Sekarang buat huru-hara! Berseronok! Nyalakan api! Buat Neferteri merah padam kerana marah! Pastikan tukar rupa kau sepenuhnya, dan jangan guna mel, atau apa-apa yang perlukan lencana kau, nanti mereka cepat jumpa kau. Pengeluaran yang aku pra-luluskan untuk kau sepatutnya tahan beberapa minggu kalau kau laburkan dengan bijak. Bebaskan diri! Buat apa kau nak!”

829d43150ef5.en: Bandit: "—kill them all on contact?" Emelia: "Do what's necessary. Our Madam has decided to make an example of her." (The Madam is Laura.) "Then we'll make a real example of her." "Don't bother me with the details. Now get out! You two are an eyesore."
829d43150ef5.t: Penyamun: “—bunuh mereka semua sebaik bersua?” Emelia: “Buat apa yang perlu. Madam kita dah putuskan untuk jadikan dia contoh.” (Madam itu ialah Laura.) “Kalau macam tu kami akan jadikan dia contoh sebenar.” “Jangan ganggu aku dengan butiran. Sekarang keluar! Korang berdua menyakitkan mata.”

82ab731ac437.en: Arukia sells goods at the market

83e18d310eed.en: They turn the corner to the restaurant. Magi takes out the key and hands it to Harry, looking away. "I did my part." Harry sees the bloodied Magi turn to leave with a sad expression. "Hey, pink adventurer, don't you want to come in and wash your clothes? You did heal me, right?" Magi, slightly blushing, points to the holes in her uniform. "I can't, or I'll wear them out even more." Harry, seeing her cute face: "I can make you supper too." Magi's stomach growls. She has no choice but to accept.
83e18d310eed.t: Mereka membelok di sudut ke restoran. Magi mengeluarkan kunci dan menyerahkannya kepada Harry, memandang ke arah lain. “Aku dah buat bahagian aku.” Harry nampak Magi yang berlumuran darah berpaling hendak pergi dengan wajah sedih. “Hei, pengembara merah jambu, kau tak nak masuk dan basuh baju kau? Kau yang sembuhkan aku, kan?” Magi, sedikit tersipu, menunjuk lubang-lubang pada pakaiannya. “Tak boleh, nanti makin lusuh.” Harry, melihat wajahnya yang comel: “Aku boleh masakkan makan malam juga.” Perut Magi berkeroncong. Dia tiada pilihan selain menerima.

84106e826860.en: As the bloodied couple walks, people give them strange looks, mostly wondering what they did to end up like that. Rumors in the background: "Hey! That's a uniform from The Wood People Picker!" "That's one of the servers!" Harry tries to cover the restaurant's logo with his hand, but the uniform gives him away easily.
84106e826860.t: Ketika pasangan berlumuran darah itu berjalan, orang memandang mereka dengan pelik, kebanyakannya tertanya-tanya apa yang mereka buat sehingga jadi begitu. Khabar angin di belakang: “Hei! Itu pakaian seragam The Wood People Picker!” “Itu salah seorang pelayan!” Harry cuba menutup logo restoran dengan tangannya, tetapi pakaian seragam itu mudah membongkarnya.

848b7f3eba95.en: Eori's friend comes in with tickets to Maiara's championship
848b7f3eba95.t: Kawan Eori masuk dengan tiket ke kejohanan Maiara

84fe447d253c.en: Magi holds out her hand, interrupting his thoughts. "Let's go already." Harry hesitates a little, but she doesn't have her bow drawn on him anymore, so now she looks cute rather than frightening. "Don't forget your bag of balls."
84fe447d253c.t: Magi menghulurkan tangan, mengganggu fikirannya. “Jom pergi dah.” Harry teragak-agak sedikit, tetapi Magi tidak lagi menghala busur kepadanya, jadi sekarang dia nampak comel dan bukannya menakutkan. “Jangan lupa beg bola kau.”

85f7ccc6f21b.en: In her quarters, Arukia puts the Bruntos to sleep on the floor
85f7ccc6f21b.t: Di biliknya, Arukia menidurkan Bruntos itu di lantai

89cf7c587205.en: The Bruntos makes a mess, and she laughs. The woman of the house interrupts to bring her a new set of clothes in exchange for the old ones. Arukia says she doesn't have much money. They reply: neither do we.
89cf7c587205.t: Bruntos itu membuat sepah, dan dia ketawa. Wanita tuan rumah mencelah untuk membawakannya sepasang pakaian baharu sebagai tukaran pakaian lama. Arukia kata dia tidak ada banyak wang. Mereka menjawab: kami pun tak ada.

89d4577e03ea.en: Someone walks in. Emelia plays along and hands over the flower they want, while the bandits pretend to browse the flowers on their own, looking clearly suspicious. The customer asks Emelia if she needs help. Emelia plays it off: those two are after the same guy, and they're trying to one-up each other in everything. People joke with them; the bandits aren't sure how to react, and wait for the customer to leave.
89d4577e03ea.t: Seseorang masuk. Emelia berlakon dan menyerahkan bunga yang dimahukan, sementara penyamun-penyamun itu berpura-pura melihat bunga sendiri, nampak jelas mencurigakan. Pelanggan itu bertanya Emelia sama ada dia perlukan bantuan. Emelia berlagak selamba: dua orang itu mengejar lelaki yang sama, dan mereka cuba mengatasi satu sama lain dalam segala hal. Orang ramai bergurau dengan mereka; penyamun-penyamun itu tidak pasti bagaimana hendak bertindak balas, dan menunggu pelanggan itu beredar.

8a8b3fc03e87.en: {WIP-eoriTeacher} asks Eori to come with her to fulfill a contract. Eori says she doesn't have time right now; the teacher says she'll simply fail her. Eori complies.
8a8b3fc03e87.t: {WIP-eoriTeacher} meminta Eori ikut dengannya untuk melaksanakan satu kontrak. Eori kata dia tiada masa sekarang; guru itu kata dia akan gagalkannya saja. Eori akur.

8aa1f42bbaea.en: She thinks about what to do with it, fights with herself, and decides to keep it. It hugs her and climbs up onto her neck. Arukia isn't sure what to do, and stays kind of cold toward it. (Bruntos are in Beasts.)
8aa1f42bbaea.t: Dia memikirkan apa nak buat dengannya, bergelut dengan dirinya sendiri, dan memutuskan untuk menyimpannya. Ia memeluknya dan memanjat ke lehernya. Arukia tidak pasti apa nak buat, dan kekal agak dingin terhadapnya. (Bruntos ada dalam Makhluk Buas.)

8c158e58d4b4.en: Magi feels the pressure, but holds her stance, and approaches Harry with her bow drawn. Tears stream down his face. "I'm—sor—ry." He can barely get a word out, struggling just to breathe.
8c158e58d4b4.t: Magi merasakan tekanan, tetapi bertahan, dan menghampiri Harry dengan busur ditarik. Air mata mengalir di wajahnya. “Ma—af—kan.” Dia hampir tidak dapat mengeluarkan sepatah kata, bergelut hanya untuk bernafas.

8c1664fbc56e.en: She uses the Create Shock spell on him. As Harry comes back to life with a huge gasp, Magi quickly readies her bow, arrow drawn on him. He cowers in fear. "Who are you?" "De—Desmond?" She draws further. "Who are you?"
8c1664fbc56e.t: Dia menggunakan jampi Create Shock padanya. Ketika Harry hidup semula dengan satu tarikan nafas yang besar, Magi cepat-cepat menyiapkan busurnya, anak panah dihala kepadanya. Dia meringkuk ketakutan. “Siapa kau?” “De—Desmond?” Dia menarik lebih jauh. “Siapa kau?”

8d86fbbb8858.en: "His appearance barely changed!" Magi grabs the badge: Harry Sanbi. She touches the badge to him again, but it doesn't light up at all. She touches the fully healed, but dead, Harry. "What's going on?"
8d86fbbb8858.t: “Rupa dia hampir tak berubah!” Magi mencapai lencana itu: Harry Sanbi. Dia menyentuhkan lencana itu pada Harry lagi, tetapi ia langsung tidak menyala. Dia menyentuh Harry yang sudah sembuh sepenuhnya, tetapi mati. “Apa yang berlaku ni?”

8dc5afd2fa9e.en: The Homeegg final is intense, and so is Maiara's play. Maiara scores a goal; Eori is still bored. People celebrate as the game goes on, and Eori goes off to buy something.
8dc5afd2fa9e.t: Final Homeegg sengit, begitu juga permainan Maiara. Maiara menjaringkan gol; Eori masih bosan. Orang ramai bersorak ketika perlawanan diteruskan, dan Eori pergi membeli sesuatu.

9286227aa2b8.en: Hanako: "Damn. All right, fine. We know Desmond fought with someone after leaving the atelier, then took off running toward a guard post. That's all we know. We used the money he gave us to pay for town-crier calls for him. Now you need to get out if you're not going to buy something. Yosuke helped pay the town crier, but he's clamping down harder on us."
9286227aa2b8.t: Hanako: “Celaka. Okey, baiklah. Kami tahu Desmond bergaduh dengan seseorang selepas tinggalkan atelier, kemudian lari ke arah pondok pengawal. Itu saja yang kami tahu. Kami guna duit yang dia bagi untuk bayar pelaung bandar memanggil dia. Sekarang korang kena keluar kalau tak nak beli apa-apa. Yosuke tolong bayar pelaung bandar, tapi dia makin ketat dengan kami.”

93567d3f122b.en: She also gets a letter from Coema: stop being a little bitch, and think for yourself for once. Neferteri will only stop controlling you when she realizes you're a lost cause. Rebel, throw a temper tantrum, have fun! If you need some investment for that, get in touch, but be sure to follow through, or I'll be worse than Neferteri.
93567d3f122b.t: Dia juga menerima surat daripada Coema: berhenti jadi jalang kecil, dan fikir sendiri buat sekali ini. Neferteri hanya akan berhenti mengawal kau bila dia sedar kau dah tak boleh diharap. Memberontak, mengamuk, berseronok! Kalau kau perlukan modal untuk tu, hubungi aku, tapi pastikan kau laksanakan, atau aku akan lebih teruk daripada Neferteri.

936db2f1db3f.en: Eori pulls out the arrow and presses her hand over the hole. "You don't have to be so fucking jumpy, you know." Magi, feeling the weight of the conspiracy, nocks another arrow. "So you made Harry disappear?" "Why would I be here, then?" Magi draws further. "To keep me from spreading the word that you were having—intimate relations with a commoner." "I cared about that at one point. Now I just want Harry back. You gonna stand there all day, or are you gonna heal me?"
936db2f1db3f.t: Eori mencabut anak panah itu dan menekan tangannya pada lubang itu. “Kau tak perlu melatah sangat, kau tahu.” Magi, merasakan beratnya konspirasi itu, memasang satu lagi anak panah. “Jadi kau yang buat Harry hilang?” “Kalau macam tu kenapa aku di sini?” Magi menarik lebih jauh. “Untuk halang aku sebarkan berita yang kau ada—hubungan intim dengan rakyat biasa.” “Aku pernah peduli pasal tu. Sekarang aku cuma nak Harry balik. Kau nak berdiri di situ sepanjang hari, atau kau nak sembuhkan aku?”

94b122f4861b.en: She can't even face her own parents, if they're even still alive after what she did to the Red Winga. She knew where they were and what the Red Winga could do, but she still went through with it, and fled it all. She hoes even harder, and then hears a cry.
94b122f4861b.t: Dia tidak sanggup pun berdepan dengan ibu bapanya sendiri, jika mereka masih hidup selepas apa yang dia buat kepada Red Winga. Dia tahu di mana mereka dan apa yang Red Winga mampu buat, tetapi dia tetap meneruskannya, dan lari daripada semuanya. Dia mencangkul lebih kuat, kemudian terdengar tangisan.

96f83aca6d2a.en: Magi and Eori make their way back to Sanbi
96f83aca6d2a.t: Magi dan Eori dalam perjalanan kembali ke Sanbi

972bc58545e9.t: Arukia menemui seekor Bruntos yang cedera

97648d9eb19b.en: Arukia: Someone was calling my name, and now this? Does Eori want Harry back this badly? Could this be my ticket out of the Red Winga? She grabs her money pouch: she can either buy a nari gel to stay on the island, or use the money to go back to Sanbi. She looks at her baby, then at her ragged clothes. They leave without buying anything.
97648d9eb19b.t: Arukia: Ada orang panggil nama aku, dan sekarang ni? Eori nak Harry balik sampai macam ni sekali ke? Mungkinkah ini tiket aku keluar dari Red Winga? Dia mencapai kantung wangnya: dia boleh sama ada membeli nari gel untuk terus tinggal di pulau itu, atau menggunakan wang itu untuk kembali ke Sanbi. Dia memandang bayinya, kemudian pakaiannya yang compang-camping. Mereka beredar tanpa membeli apa-apa.

97755385fee5.en: Yosuke bangs his metal ladle on something to wake everyone. He bonks Dalila on the head to get her up; Harry looks at the open window.
97755385fee5.t: Yosuke mengetuk senduk logamnya pada sesuatu untuk membangunkan semua orang. Dia mengetuk kepala Dalila untuk membangunkannya; Harry memandang tingkap yang terbuka.

97f7287d83b2.en: She thinks about things: her life, her father, and so on. Then Harry appears in her mind. She wakes up, trying to clear her head, but his smile when he invited her in keeps nagging at her. Then Morika, and Eori. Did Eori really love some random guy from the Sanbi slums?
97f7287d83b2.t: Dia memikirkan banyak perkara: hidupnya, ayahnya, dan sebagainya. Kemudian Harry muncul dalam fikirannya. Dia terjaga, cuba menjernihkan fikiran, tetapi senyuman Harry ketika mengajaknya masuk terus mengganggunya. Kemudian Morika, dan Eori. Adakah Eori betul-betul mencintai seorang lelaki entah siapa dari setinggan Sanbi?

9829c5ad9c27.en: Magi sees how many balls are in it. "What do you want from me?" "Help—me find Harry. You know what he looks like." Magi eyes the inviting bag. "P—post a quest, and we'll talk about it!" "I can't fucking do that! Mom will realize what I'm trying to do!" "Mom? You mean the queen of Sanbi?" "Who else, you dumb bitch? I'm trying to break free of her grip! I'm sick of this shit!" Magi: "All right. Fine. Let's go back to the restaurant. Just remember, he was called Desmond."
9829c5ad9c27.t: Magi nampak berapa banyak bola di dalamnya. “Apa kau nak daripada aku?” “Tolong—aku cari Harry. Kau tahu rupa dia.” Magi merenung beg yang menggoda itu. “L—letak misi, dan kita bincang!” “Aku tak boleh buat macam tu, celaka! Mak akan sedar apa aku cuba buat!” “Mak? Maksud kau permaisuri Sanbi?” “Siapa lagi, kau jalang bodoh? Aku cuba nak lepas daripada cengkaman dia! Aku dah muak dengan semua karut ni!” Magi: “Okey. Baiklah. Jom balik ke restoran. Cuma ingat, dia dipanggil Desmond.”

9a7bc8950aec.en: She bows and starts off, then weighs her green bag, opens it and peeks inside: several small Fost stones, about the size of a piece of gum. She turns around. "Did I drop some, by any chance?" The older lady looks away. "I'm sure they're all there, sweetie." Then she looks back. "Unless… are you saying we're bandits?" Magi feels an ominous presence from them. Someone at the back: "What do you say? Let's call it a rescue fee?"
9a7bc8950aec.t: Dia menunduk hormat dan mula berjalan, kemudian menimbang beg hijaunya, membukanya dan mengintai ke dalam: beberapa Fost stone kecil, lebih kurang sebesar sekeping gula-gula getah. Dia berpaling. “Ada saya tercicir beberapa, kebetulan?” Wanita tua itu memandang ke arah lain. “Mak cik pasti semuanya ada di situ, sayang.” Kemudian dia memandang balik. “Melainkan… kau kata kami penyamun?” Magi merasakan kehadiran yang menyeramkan daripada mereka. Seseorang di belakang: “Macam mana? Kita panggil yuran menyelamat?”

9bc357915d7b.en: An older lady scolds her as she hands over her things. "Lady! You need to be more careful! There are bandits around!" The girl in pink takes her bow, attaches it to her backpack and puts it on. "I'm sorry!"
9bc357915d7b.t: Seorang wanita tua memarahinya ketika menyerahkan barangnya. “Cik! Kau kena lebih berhati-hati! Ada penyamun di sekitar sini!” Gadis berbaju merah jambu itu mengambil busurnya, menyangkutnya pada beg galas dan memakainya. “Maaf!”

a068e9eca10a.en: His hand freezes. "Morika Tolerideme. An adventurer protecting Princess Eori." Eori, now on Magi's side: "What the fuck are you doing here?" Morika slowly takes out his badge. "You're an invaluable target for kidnapping." Eori looks at the lit-up badge, clearly saying Morika. "Oh! So you're gonna kidnap me instead?" She remembers being kidnapped by Namia and Posaqui. "You know what? You can all go fuck yourselves. I'm not her little bitch anymore!" She walks off, away from Morika.
a068e9eca10a.t: Tangannya kaku. “Morika Tolerideme. Pengembara yang melindungi Puteri Eori.” Eori, kini di pihak Magi: “Apa celaka kau buat di sini?” Morika perlahan-lahan mengeluarkan lencananya. “Tuan puteri sasaran penculikan yang tidak ternilai.” Eori memandang lencana yang menyala, jelas tertulis Morika. “Oh! Jadi kau pula nak culik aku?” Dia teringat diculik oleh Namia dan Posaqui. “Kau tahu apa? Korang semua boleh pergi mampus. Aku bukan jalang kecil dia lagi!” Dia berjalan pergi, menjauhi Morika.

a0ba6b72fc70.en: The clerk hands her about 2 Pearls; Magi asleep in a seat with her backpack and bow
a0ba6b72fc70.t: Kerani menyerahkan lebih kurang 2 Pearl kepadanya; Magi tertidur di kerusi dengan beg galas dan busurnya

a0e663a3037c.en: Desmond leans back. "You okay? You just passed out cold." Magi glares at him. "Don't touch me!" "DESMOND! STOP FLIRTING AND CLEAN THIS SHIT UP!" Rimir's scream from the kitchen door breaks the awkwardness filling the room. "Sorry, pink adventurer. I'll grab you another drink. You can stay here until I finish cleaning up the floor."
a0e663a3037c.t: Desmond bersandar ke belakang. “Kau okey? Kau tiba-tiba pengsan.” Magi menjelingnya. “Jangan sentuh aku!” “DESMOND! BERHENTI MENGURAT DAN BERSIHKAN TAIK NI!” Jeritan Rimir dari pintu dapur memecahkan kejanggalan yang memenuhi bilik. “Maaf, pengembara merah jambu. Aku ambilkan kau minuman lain. Kau boleh tunggu di sini sampai aku habis bersihkan lantai.”

a16e52fefa20.en: As Eori walks away, Morika glances at her, puts his badge away, and looks at Harry, looking pretty dead, and at Magi, frozen, not quite getting how a princess could say something like that. He takes out a pouch of balls and tosses it at Harry's feet. "Apologies for Princess Eori's behavior. She mistook you for someone she knew."
a16e52fefa20.t: Ketika Eori berjalan pergi, Morika mengerlingnya, menyimpan lencananya, dan memandang Harry, yang nampak hampir mati, dan Magi, kaku, tidak begitu faham bagaimana seorang puteri boleh berkata begitu. Dia mengeluarkan sekantung bola dan mencampaknya ke kaki Harry. “Maafkan kelakuan Puteri Eori. Dia tersalah sangka kau orang yang dikenalinya.”

a2e87f72ca6e.en: On the wagon, Magi falls asleep on Eori's shoulder, and Eori slaps her awake. That drives them further apart, since Magi hides that she has narcolepsy.
a2e87f72ca6e.t: Di atas gerabak, Magi tertidur di bahu Eori, dan Eori menamparnya hingga terjaga. Itu menjauhkan mereka lagi, kerana Magi menyembunyikan bahawa dia menghidap narkolepsi.

a331c4fa1d66.en: Magi, nervous, at the corner, watching the building; the door is closed, but there's still light inside
a331c4fa1d66.t: Magi, gugup, di sudut jalan, memerhati bangunan itu; pintu tertutup, tetapi masih ada cahaya di dalam

a36da4310d64.en: Magi at the Embassy at the crack of dawn; the clerk has a copy of the badge
a36da4310d64.t: Magi di Kedutaan awal subuh; kerani ada salinan lencana itu

a75bb553a801.en: A construction guy walks in, looking turned on. Ryo laughs. "Damn! This place is gonna do nicely. How can I help ya?" "We're finishing prepping the walls. Have you decided on the color scheme?" "Crap, I forgot to ask you about that." Katsumi decides on a name on the spot, {WIP-katsumiWhorehouse}, plus the color scheme. Ryo: "There's your answer."
a75bb553a801.t: Seorang pekerja binaan masuk, nampak terangsang. Ryo ketawa. “Celaka! Tempat ni akan maju. Apa aku boleh bantu?” “Kami tengah siapkan dinding. Tuan dah putuskan skema warna?” “Alamak, aku lupa nak tanya kau pasal tu.” Katsumi memutuskan nama di situ juga, {WIP-katsumiWhorehouse}, serta skema warnanya. Ryo: “Itulah jawapan kau.”

a8bf0e507072.en: Looking at herself in the mirror, it dawns on her that Harry is still out there. She could have gotten some information out of that fake Harry about where he found a Harry-based nari gel, but she was too angry to think of it. She breaks something in anger, which makes her even more furious. "Now I have to go through every single nari gel vendor to find out where it was made…"
a8bf0e507072.t: Memandang dirinya di cermin, barulah dia sedar Harry masih ada di luar sana. Dia boleh dapatkan sedikit maklumat daripada Harry palsu itu tentang di mana dia menemui nari gel berasaskan Harry, tetapi dia terlalu marah untuk terfikir. Dia memecahkan sesuatu kerana marah, yang membuatnya lebih berang. “Sekarang aku kena periksa setiap penjual nari gel untuk tahu di mana ia dibuat…”

a981aa55fb02.en: Harry helps them set up shop while Dalila, Yosuke and Rimir cook; Magi somewhere in the background
a981aa55fb02.t: Harry membantu mereka menyediakan gerai sementara Dalila, Yosuke dan Rimir memasak; Magi di suatu tempat di belakang

aa2c38b26298.en: She'll use something to test his soul, and see that it doesn't work. She'll refuse to believe it, while the people around her use it as proof that she's misbehaving, and let Harry go free.
aa2c38b26298.t: Dia akan menggunakan sesuatu untuk menguji jiwanya, dan melihat ia tidak berfungsi. Dia akan enggan mempercayainya, sementara orang di sekelilingnya menggunakannya sebagai bukti bahawa dia berkelakuan buruk, dan melepaskan Harry.

aabc0163f230.en: Eori, her appearance changed with nari gels, in a cheap room
aabc0163f230.t: Eori, rupanya diubah dengan nari gel, di sebuah bilik murah

ad2f464ec672.en: The next morning, Magi stands in front of The Wood People Picker
ad2f464ec672.t: Pagi esoknya, Magi berdiri di depan The Wood People Picker

ae56032acc3c.en: "Going to sign another? I have a few." Magi: "Whatever's safest, for the most money." "More roadwork, I presume?" Magi nods, holding the two Pearls. She pulls out her badge, makes it light up, and hands the two Pearls back. "Can you please add these to the Blue-Flower-Red-Bone guild?" The clerk doesn't take them. Instead, he smiles. "I'll get the contracts arranged. Please excuse me."
ae56032acc3c.t: “Nak tandatangan lagi? Saya ada beberapa.” Magi: “Apa saja yang paling selamat, untuk wang paling banyak.” “Kerja jalan raya lagi, saya agak?” Magi mengangguk, memegang dua Pearl itu. Dia mengeluarkan lencananya, membuatnya menyala, dan menyerahkan semula dua Pearl itu. “Boleh tolong tambah ini ke persatuan Blue-Flower-Red-Bone?” Kerani tidak mengambilnya. Sebaliknya, dia tersenyum. “Saya akan uruskan kontrak-kontrak itu. Maafkan saya sebentar.”

af7df03ae7ab.en: To Magi, Eori seems kind of controlling, and antisocial. She wonders if Harry running away from her was a sign that something bad happened between them.
af7df03ae7ab.t: Bagi Magi, Eori nampak agak suka mengawal, dan antisosial. Dia tertanya-tanya sama ada Harry melarikan diri daripadanya satu petanda sesuatu yang buruk berlaku antara mereka.

af8cf250a0df.en: Eori has an altercation with Morika, who has basically put her under house arrest
af8cf250a0df.t: Eori bertengkar dengan Morika, yang pada dasarnya meletakkannya di bawah tahanan rumah

b04499d5cbd7.en: Hanako clears her throat as she comes closer. "Then what are you doing in his room, drenched in sweat?" Magi looks at her damp clothes, and her face turns redder. "It's not what you're thinking! I passed out!" "Ohhhhhh—he's that good?" Magi stares back, not understanding.
b04499d5cbd7.t: Hanako berdehem sambil mendekat. “Habis apa kau buat dalam bilik dia, basah kuyup dengan peluh?” Magi memandang pakaiannya yang lembap, dan mukanya semakin merah. “Bukan macam yang kau fikir! Aku pengsan!” “Ohhhhhh—hebat sangat ke dia?” Magi merenung balik, tidak faham.

b24168a24ddd.en: Hanako and Mimi tell Magi to get fucked for not helping find Desmond. Magi says she's investigating what happened to him now. Hanako probes her, but she dodges.
b24168a24ddd.t: Hanako dan Mimi menyuruh Magi pergi mampus kerana tidak membantu mencari Desmond. Magi kata dia sedang menyiasat apa yang berlaku kepadanya sekarang. Hanako mengoreknya, tetapi dia mengelak.

b3011bcf594e.en: They leave. Magi asks what Eori's relationship with him is. Eori says they were lovers, fleeing Neferteri's grasp. Magi takes it in, but something doesn't feel right.
b3011bcf594e.t: Mereka beredar. Magi bertanya apa hubungan Eori dengannya. Eori kata mereka kekasih, lari daripada cengkaman Neferteri. Magi menerimanya, tetapi ada sesuatu yang terasa tak kena.

b56bff2eb24b.en: Ryo is mesmerized by her ability to eat Barinas like no one else; Katsuki is so focused she doesn't even offer him any. "You like Barinas that much?" Katsuki, frog juice dripping down her chin, nods and keeps going.
b56bff2eb24b.t: Ryo terpukau dengan keupayaannya makan Barinas tidak seperti orang lain; Katsuki begitu fokus sehingga tidak menawarkannya pun. “Kau suka Barina sangat ke?” Katsuki, jus katak menitis di dagunya, mengangguk dan terus makan.

b7a4bd08ee56.en: Magi startles awake, with no idea where she is, her head pounding. Her backpack and bow are missing, but searching frantically, she finds them right by the bed. Her clothes are damp, but the warmth of the bed makes her feel better.
b7a4bd08ee56.t: Magi tersentak bangun, tidak tahu di mana dia berada, kepalanya berdenyut. Beg galas dan busurnya hilang, tetapi mencari dengan panik, dia menemuinya betul-betul di tepi katil. Pakaiannya lembap, tetapi kehangatan katil membuatnya rasa lebih baik.

b7a824acd3ca.en: Assistant: "I heard all about it in the letter. You two are indeed quite cute. With that in mind, here's a gift I bought." She brings out a kimono-like outfit for each of them. Ryo: "Actually, I forgot to tell you: only Katsumi will be running this place. Katsuki wants to travel with me instead." "You want to travel with her instead. I know how this goes."
b7a824acd3ca.t: Pembantu: “Saya dah dengar semuanya dalam surat. Kamu berdua memang comel. Dengan itu, ini hadiah yang saya beli.” Dia mengeluarkan pakaian seperti kimono untuk setiap seorang. Ryo: “Sebenarnya, aku terlupa nak beritahu kau: hanya Katsumi yang akan uruskan tempat ni. Katsuki nak mengembara dengan aku.” “Tuan yang nak mengembara dengan dia. Saya tahu macam mana benda ni.”

b8b3d4594570.en: Tons of food are ready, and they celebrate. Yosuke tells them to rest well: the wagons arrive at Sunnalow to pick up the food, and they'd better be ready!
b8b3d4594570.t: Berlambak makanan sudah siap, dan mereka meraikan. Yosuke menyuruh mereka berehat secukupnya: gerabak tiba pada Sunnalow untuk mengambil makanan, dan baik mereka bersedia!

b8ca6ba0b6db.en: Magi, holding the key, looks at the dead Harry and gives him the last bit of Nari Refresher she has. Harry loses some weight as his body recovers, but the only change in his appearance is his hair turning black again.
b8ca6ba0b6db.t: Magi, memegang kunci itu, memandang Harry yang mati dan memberinya sisa terakhir Nari Refresher yang dimilikinya. Harry susut sedikit berat ketika badannya pulih, tetapi satu-satunya perubahan pada rupanya ialah rambutnya kembali hitam.

b9526b14c9a3.en: Harry eats a nari gel to improve his eyes. It hurts. Magi keeps to herself.
b9526b14c9a3.t: Harry makan nari gel untuk memperbaiki matanya. Sakit. Magi berdiam diri.

b96e4cff3c38.en: Arukia, hiding somewhere in Endlessfog, hoes in the sun. She stops for a second to watch a passing boat and wonders how long she's been here. Maybe it's for the better: no more Red Winga, no more Harry, no more anyone. Just her.
b96e4cff3c38.t: Arukia, bersembunyi di suatu tempat di Endlessfog, mencangkul di bawah matahari. Dia berhenti seketika untuk memerhati bot yang lalu dan tertanya-tanya sudah berapa lama dia di sini. Mungkin lebih baik begini: tiada lagi Red Winga, tiada lagi Harry, tiada lagi sesiapa. Hanya dia.

bb4a6a5e5771.en: Her heart races thinking of all the money she'd get. Then she remembers something from back in Blood, when she applied to the guild to become a Pearl: she can borrow a suspect's badge for up to a week, but if she loses it, she pays ten times the price or is forced to work until the debt is paid off, plus other fees if she takes more than a week. (The Missing Person rule: only for adventurers investigating with a good lead.) She decides she'll do it.
bb4a6a5e5771.t: Jantungnya berdegup kencang memikirkan semua wang yang akan diperolehnya. Kemudian dia teringat sesuatu dari Blood dahulu, ketika dia memohon kepada persatuan untuk menjadi Pearl: dia boleh meminjam lencana suspek sehingga seminggu, tetapi jika dia kehilangannya, dia membayar sepuluh kali ganda harganya atau dipaksa bekerja sehingga hutang dibayar, ditambah yuran lain jika dia mengambil lebih daripada seminggu. (Peraturan Missing Person: hanya untuk pengembara yang menyiasat dengan petunjuk yang baik.) Dia memutuskan dia akan melakukannya.

bba0f92a584e.en: They're carrying something when they get hurt in a landslide. Arukia shields the baby Bruntos, but breaks her ribs, and more.
bba0f92a584e.t: Mereka sedang membawa sesuatu apabila tercedera dalam tanah runtuh. Arukia melindungi bayi Bruntos itu, tetapi rusuknya patah, dan lebih lagi.

bc7e2c1df249.en: A poke on her cheek wakes her: the same clerk, handing her a measly two Pearls. "Hey, miss. You didn't return all the stones." She holds out her hands and he places them there, then shows her the contract: she got more Fost stones from them than she brought back. Magi clutches the two Pearls to her chest, holding back her tears. The clerk waves the contract; she signs it.
bc7e2c1df249.t: Cucukan di pipinya membangunkannya: kerani yang sama, menyerahkan dua Pearl yang tidak seberapa. “Hei, cik. Cik tak pulangkan semua batu.” Dia menghulurkan tangan dan kerani meletakkannya di situ, kemudian menunjukkan kontrak: dia mengambil lebih banyak Fost stone daripada mereka berbanding yang dibawanya balik. Magi memeluk dua Pearl itu ke dadanya, menahan air mata. Kerani mengibas kontrak itu; dia menandatanganinya.

beb263296a34.en: Her friend ({WIP-eoriRoommate}) comes into the room with tickets to Maiara's championship. Eori snaps at her, but the girl snaps right back, showing who's boss. They argue, and in the end the friend wins: Eori lets her win before she flips her shit and kills her on the spot.
beb263296a34.t: Kawannya ({WIP-eoriRoommate}) masuk ke bilik dengan tiket ke kejohanan Maiara. Eori membentaknya, tetapi gadis itu membentak balik, menunjukkan siapa bos. Mereka bertengkar, dan akhirnya kawannya menang: Eori membiarkannya menang sebelum dia hilang akal dan membunuhnya di situ juga.

c08a042d0f6d.en: They argue about Soul research being futile and dangerous. The teacher realizes what Eori is after. "You think you're the only one who wants to bring back a loved one? We all did! But the soul doesn't care!"
c08a042d0f6d.t: Mereka bertengkar tentang penyelidikan Jiwa yang sia-sia dan berbahaya. Guru itu sedar apa yang Eori kejar. “Kau ingat kau seorang saja yang nak hidupkan semula orang tersayang? Kami semua pernah! Tapi jiwa tak peduli!”

c46cd2162445.en: He leads the pink adventurer to a table in the corner, looks around suspiciously, then speaks loudly: "I'm Desmond! How can I serve you today?" Then, quieter: "You're supposed to at least buy something, but don't tell anybody, or I'll be in trouble."
c46cd2162445.t: Dia membawa pengembara berbaju merah jambu itu ke sebuah meja di sudut, melihat sekeliling dengan curiga, kemudian bercakap kuat: “Saya Desmond! Boleh saya bantu hari ini?” Kemudian, lebih perlahan: “Kau sepatutnya sekurang-kurangnya beli sesuatu, tapi jangan beritahu sesiapa, nanti aku dapat masalah.”

c4ce65608f29.en: Eori drops her drink, rushes at him and tackles him to the ground. Harry, realizing who it is, puts his hand on her shoulder and tries to push her away while she forces herself on top of him for a kiss.
c4ce65608f29.t: Eori menjatuhkan minumannya, meluru ke arahnya dan menerkamnya ke tanah. Harry, sedar siapa itu, meletakkan tangan di bahunya dan cuba menolaknya sementara Eori memaksa dirinya ke atas Harry untuk mencium.

c53fc66986c9.en: Someone finds them and offers Arukia a Nari Refresher. She says no, but too late: it's given to her, and she heals. The baby monkey looks at her, not quite understanding, but when it smells her, it hugs her.
c53fc66986c9.t: Seseorang menemui mereka dan menawarkan Nari Refresher kepada Arukia. Dia kata tidak, tetapi terlambat: ia sudah diberikan kepadanya, dan dia sembuh. Bayi monyet itu memandangnya, tidak begitu faham, tetapi apabila ia menghidunya, ia memeluknya.

c6bd169bd146.en: She asks where that one comes from. The vendor says he got it cheap from a boat coming from Sanbi. They sold it so cheap he doesn't even know how they made a profit.
c6bd169bd146.t: Dia bertanya dari mana datangnya yang itu. Penjual kata dia dapatnya murah daripada bot yang datang dari Sanbi. Mereka menjualnya begitu murah sehingga dia sendiri tidak tahu bagaimana mereka mendapat untung.

c6d471d577f4.en: Katsuki points at one face. "One—Harry." "Oh! You know the guy?" Ryo: "We know him. Yes. Can you tell me where you got it?" "I'll tell you if you buy one. I'll even do buy one, get one free." "What kind of info is this?" "My distributor, of course!" Ryo smiles. "{WIP-ryoDistributor}?" The guy looks surprised. "How the heck do you know him?" Ryo pulls out a couple of Pearls. "I've lived long enough."
c6d471d577f4.t: Katsuki menunjuk satu wajah. “Satu—Harry.” “Oh! Kau kenal lelaki ni?” Ryo: “Kami kenal dia. Ya. Boleh beritahu di mana kau dapat?” “Aku beritahu kalau kau beli satu. Aku malah bagi beli satu, percuma satu.” “Maklumat jenis apa ni?” “Pengedar aku, sudah tentu!” Ryo tersenyum. “{WIP-ryoDistributor}?” Lelaki itu nampak terkejut. “Macam mana kau kenal dia?” Ryo mengeluarkan beberapa Pearl. “Aku dah hidup cukup lama.”

c806214248ad.en: Magi wakes up against a wall; an old Cruro shows her a handwritten note: "You okay?" (her green bag isn't as full as before)
c806214248ad.t: Magi terjaga bersandar pada dinding; seorang Cruro tua menunjukkan nota tulisan tangan kepadanya: “Kau okey?” (beg hijaunya tidak sepenuh tadi)

c936d99ecdf8.en: Hanako: "You should leave before Yosuke comes back, or he'll punish Desmond." Magi does, grabbing a handful of Pearls, but as she walks out she hears Hanako's loud whisper: "Desmond's got a thing for girly adventurers!" Magi acts as if she didn't hear, but embarrassment tickles her as she walks out.
c936d99ecdf8.t: Hanako: “Baik kau pergi sebelum Yosuke balik, nanti dia hukum Desmond.” Magi beredar, mengambil segenggam Pearl, tetapi ketika dia keluar dia mendengar bisikan kuat Hanako: “Desmond memang suka pengembara feminin!” Magi berlagak seolah-olah tidak mendengar, tetapi rasa malu menggeletek dirinya ketika dia keluar.

c95d6b9a931d.en: "Miss pink adventurer!" Mimi flies over to Magi and asks loudly: "Have you seen Desmond?" Magi feels strange as the restaurant workers and patrons turn their attention to her. "I haven't seen him since yesterday."
c95d6b9a931d.t: “Cik pengembara merah jambu!” Mimi terbang ke arah Magi dan bertanya kuat: “Ada nampak Desmond?” Magi rasa pelik ketika pekerja dan pelanggan restoran mengalihkan perhatian kepadanya. “Aku tak nampak dia sejak semalam.”

caabe3c28c8c.en: Magi realizes Harry is dying, so he won't be taking off again. She eases her bow, and dips Harry's badge in the pool of his own blood.
caabe3c28c8c.t: Magi sedar Harry sedang nazak, jadi dia tidak akan lari lagi. Dia melonggarkan busurnya, dan mencelup lencana Harry ke dalam takungan darahnya sendiri.

cab5a3578781.en: She'll appear more, to instigate Eori and Eiri onto a "good" path… (still open).
cab5a3578781.t: Dia akan muncul lebih kerap, untuk menghasut Eori dan Eiri ke jalan yang “baik”… (masih terbuka).

cda79f169a0d.en: She notices the note. Pink Adventurer, I told you that you could borrow Hanako's clothes. I went to an atelier to get my uniform patched up. Here's a proper thank you. There's a handful of Pearls, and the food. Her starving stomach demands she swallow it whole; she slurps it up in a hurry, but it tastes kind of salty, and some of the spices are off.
cda79f169a0d.t: Dia perasan nota itu. Pengembara Merah Jambu, aku dah cakap kau boleh pinjam baju Hanako. Aku pergi ke atelier untuk tampal pakaian seragam aku. Ini tanda terima kasih yang sewajarnya. Ada segenggam Pearl, dan makanan itu. Perutnya yang kelaparan menuntutnya menelan semuanya; dia menghirupnya tergesa-gesa, tetapi rasanya agak masin, dan sesetengah rempahnya tak kena.

ce2fead793d0.en: Harry notices Magi in the background, but doesn't think much of it.
ce2fead793d0.t: Harry perasan Magi di belakang, tetapi tidak terlalu memikirkannya.

ceda51afa30a.en: Magi anxiously waits while the Embassy clerk counts the Fost stones. She watches his hand move each small stone from one pile to the other, her eyes following the repetitive motion, growing wearier with each one. She tries not to blink at all costs, but her eyelids fight her tooth and nail. She gives in to one quick blink.
ceda51afa30a.t: Magi menunggu dengan cemas sementara kerani Kedutaan mengira Fost stone. Dia memerhati tangan kerani itu memindahkan setiap batu kecil dari satu longgok ke longgok lain, matanya mengikut gerakan berulang itu, semakin letih dengan setiap satu. Dia cuba tidak berkelip walau apa pun, tetapi kelopak matanya melawan habis-habisan. Dia mengalah untuk satu kelipan pantas.

cfc4f5242e45.en: Yosuke grills her: "What are you doing to his uniform? He hasn't paid it off yet!" Magi, who knows a fair bit about how this works, carefully finishes pulling out the arrow. "I'm sorry, but I thought he was Harry from Sanbi." "He's Desmond from Rebula! Did you even think to ask? Look at him! You ruined the uniform!" "I'm sorry about the arrow, but Princess Eori was the one who kicked him!" "So they weren't lying when they told me Princess Eori tackled Desmond to the ground." Magi, digging through her backpack: "I saw it too."
cfc4f5242e45.t: Yosuke memarahinya: “Apa kau buat pada pakaian seragam dia? Dia belum habis bayar lagi!” Magi, yang tahu agak banyak tentang hal ini, dengan berhati-hati menghabiskan mencabut anak panah itu. “Maaf, tapi saya ingat dia Harry dari Sanbi.” “Dia Desmond dari Rebula! Kau ada terfikir nak tanya? Tengok dia! Kau rosakkan pakaian seragam!” “Saya minta maaf pasal anak panah, tapi Puteri Eori yang tendang dia!” “Jadi mereka tak tipu bila beritahu aku Puteri Eori terkam Desmond ke tanah.” Magi, menyelongkar beg galasnya: “Saya nampak juga.”

d08e64c9e6de.en: The Cruro smells the blood. Arukia is afraid it'll know who she truly is, but it doesn't: this Cruro has lived here its entire life. The person: "Were you trying to look like its first owner?" Arukia: "Yeah. That." The person laughs out loud. "That's pretty stupid. They recognize you by your smell. You'd need a full-body nari to trick them. Anyway, let's have supper, and you two can bathe before heading home."
d08e64c9e6de.t: Cruro itu menghidu darah. Arukia takut ia akan tahu siapa dirinya sebenarnya, tetapi tidak: Cruro ini tinggal di sini seumur hidupnya. Orang itu: “Kau cuba nak nampak macam tuan pertama dia ke?” Arukia: “Ya. Macam tu la.” Orang itu ketawa kuat. “Bodoh betul. Mereka kenal kau melalui bau. Kau perlukan nari seluruh badan untuk menipu mereka. Apa-apa pun, jom makan malam, dan korang berdua boleh mandi sebelum balik.”

d225f8560753.en: They notice Harry's face among the gels. Eori has an altercation with the vendor and gets the info, and they hear the same story: cheap gels from Sanbi. Magi heals the guy back up, while Eori spits on him and walks away.
d225f8560753.t: Mereka perasan wajah Harry di antara gel-gel itu. Eori bertengkar dengan penjual dan mendapat maklumat, dan mereka mendengar cerita yang sama: gel murah dari Sanbi. Magi menyembuhkan lelaki itu semula, sementara Eori meludahnya dan beredar.

d257fa4c350f.en: Magi realizes Harry gave most of his money away, which left him almost nothing to flee with. They ask her to find him; she tells them to post a search quest, and leaves. "But he doesn't have a badge!"
d257fa4c350f.t: Magi sedar Harry memberikan kebanyakan wangnya, yang meninggalkannya hampir tiada apa-apa untuk melarikan diri. Mereka memintanya mencari Harry; dia menyuruh mereka meletakkan misi pencarian, dan beredar. “Tapi dia tak ada lencana!”

d47b251a3b3c.en: Magi sees how much he's cowering. She looks at where she's hidden his badge, and lowers her bow with a defeated expression. "An older guy in the same uniform as you gave me the key to the restaurant and asked me to take you there." Harry looks at his uniform and touches it in disbelief. "Oh no. He's gonna punish me!" Magi feels like an asshole. "I'm sorry about the arrow, but Princess Eori did most of it."
d47b251a3b3c.t: Magi nampak betapa dia meringkuk.
